title: Company News For January 2, 2018 - January

organizations.name: united states district court for delaware netflix, inc

text: Shares of Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. ( GS - Free Report ) declined 0.7% after saying that its fourth-quarter earnings will be reduced by around $5 billion per thenew tax law Apple Inc’s ( AAPL - Free Report ) shares slumped 1.1%  after apologizing for the lack of transparency related to handling of iPhone performance with older batteries Shares of Priceline Group Inc. ( PCLN - Free Report ) decreased 1.5% after the company and IBM ( IBM - Free Report ) agreed to resolve a patent lawsuit pending in the United States District Court for Delaware Netflix, Inc’s ( NFLX - Free Report ) shares fell 0.4% after revealing that the salary of the company’s top executives will be increased in 2018 followingthe launch of the new tax law
